Pulse 0.1.5 expands the exercise library and makes muscle targeting easier to understand.

## What's new

- Added 72 built-in exercises covering the main muscle groups and common equipment.
- Added detailed front and back muscle maps to exercise previews.
- Added male and female body-map options under Appearance settings.
- Added separate set groups so an exercise can use different reps, weight, and rest times.
- Added a dedicated mobile exercise preview before adding or editing an exercise.
- Added an explicit setting for online exercise images, which remains off by default on new installations.
- Added controls for clearing locally cached exercise images.

## Library behaviour

- App updates can add or refresh built-in exercises without removing custom exercises.
- Existing archive choices are preserved when the built-in library is refreshed.
- Updating exercise definitions does not replace set prescriptions or workout notes.
- Exercises already in the selected day are hidden from its add-exercise picker.

## Improvements and fixes

- Reworked the exercise picker for phone screens and removed overlapping controls.
- Fixed muscle maps appearing behind or between exercise rows.
- Improved the Latte light theme with calmer surfaces, softer accent fills, and lighter shadows.
- Improved import validation for set groups and body-map preferences.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/nyxar77/Pulse/compare/0.1.4...0.1.5
